title: Game Pieces
instructions:
Complete the abstract `GamePiece` class and its two subclasses `Cone` and `Cube`.

The `GamePiece` class has:
- An abstract property `name: String`
- An abstract property `points: Int`
- A regular method `describe()` that returns "{name} is worth {points} points"

The `Cone` class should have name "Cone" and points 3.
The `Cube` class should have name "Cube" and points 4.
hint: Use `override val name = "Cone"` and `override val points = 3` inside the Cone class. Do the same for Cube with its values.
